connectors.name: Salesforce
connectors.summary: CRM accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasts and customer activity.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires customer-authorized Salesforce tenant, edition/API entitlement and any applicable vendor fees.

connectors.name: QuickBooks Online
connectors.summary: Accounting records, invoices, expenses, vendors, accounts and financial summaries.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires an authorized QuickBooks Online company and applicable Intuit plan/API access.

connectors.name: Xero
connectors.summary: Accounting, bank reconciliation, invoices, bills and financial reporting.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires customer-authorized Xero organization and applicable API access.

connectors.name: Oracle NetSuite
connectors.summary: ERP financials, order-to-cash, procurement and operating data.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires customer NetSuite licensing, account configuration and approved integration method.

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.summary: Payment events, invoices, subscriptions, refunds and reconciliation signals.
connectors.commercialNote: Financial actions require explicit scopes, approval controls and provider-side authorization; never store secret keys in browser code.

connectors.name: Microsoft Power BI
connectors.summary: Governed dashboards, datasets and executive performance reporting.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires tenant consent, licensing and dataset/workspace permissions.

connectors.name: Tableau
connectors.summary: Business intelligence dashboards and governed analytics.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires Tableau deployment access, licensing and project/workbook permissions.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.summary: Repositories, pull requests, issues, actions, releases and engineering delivery signals.
connectors.commercialNote: Install only in approved organizations/repositories; request least-privilege permissions.

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.summary: Repositories, merge requests, CI pipelines, releases and security findings.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires customer-authorized GitLab group/project scopes.

connectors.name: Microsoft Azure
connectors.summary: Cloud subscriptions, resource inventory, cost and operational telemetry.
connectors.commercialNote: Use tenant consent and narrowly scoped service principals; avoid broad subscription Owner grants.

connectors.name: Amazon Web Services
connectors.summary: AWS account inventory, resource metadata, cost and operational signals.
connectors.commercialNote: Use cross-account role assumption with external ID and least-privilege policies.

connectors.name: Google Cloud
connectors.summary: Projects, cloud resource inventory, service health and cost signals.
connectors.commercialNote: Use customer-managed service identities and minimal project-level roles.

connectors.name: Microsoft Entra ID
connectors.summary: Directory users, groups, sign-in and identity lifecycle signals.
connectors.commercialNote: Privileged directory scopes require admin consent, explicit justification and audit.

connectors.name: Okta
connectors.summary: Identity lifecycle, groups, authentication and access events.
connectors.commercialNote: Use a dedicated integration account and least-privilege scopes; vault credentials server-side.

connectors.name: Microsoft Intune
connectors.summary: Managed endpoint inventory, compliance state and device actions where authorized.
connectors.commercialNote: Remote device actions require explicit elevated permissions, confirmation and audit.

connectors.name: Microsoft Sentinel
connectors.summary: Security incidents, alerts, analytics and investigation context.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires workspace permissions and clear boundaries for incident response actions.

connectors.name: CrowdStrike Falcon
connectors.summary: Endpoint detections, host context and response actions where separately approved.
connectors.commercialNote: Endpoint isolation or response actions must use separate permissions and confirmation gates.

connectors.name: Datadog
connectors.summary: Infrastructure metrics, logs, traces, monitors and service health.
connectors.commercialNote: Store API/application keys in a managed server-side secret vault; define retention and ingestion costs.

connectors.name: ServiceNow
connectors.summary: Incidents, changes, service requests, CMDB and operational workflows.
connectors.commercialNote: Use scoped integration user/roles and map tenant, assignment and record ACL boundaries.

connectors.name: Asana
connectors.summary: Strategic initiatives, project ownership, milestones and execution status.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires authorized workspace and project access.

connectors.name: monday.com
connectors.summary: Cross-functional initiatives, operating plans, ownership and status.
connectors.commercialNote: Requires authorized account/workspace and board permissions.

connectors.name: Atlassian Jira
connectors.summary: Strategic programs, delivery roadmaps, project status and engineering work.
connectors.commercialNote: Scopes should be restricted to selected sites/projects and mapped to tenant access.

commercialRules.connectorPricing: Connector subscription, usage, API, and vendor license fees must be disclosed separately from IntelliStack package pricing.
commercialRules.packageEntitlements: Packages may include connector slots, categories, governance capabilities, or support levels; exact quantities remain proposed until approved.
commercialRules.addOns: A connector may be offered as a standalone add-on or bundle only after dependency, readiness, and entitlement checks.
commercialRules.tierIndependence: Role recommendation must not silently upgrade a subscription or grant a paid entitlement.
